name: Wizard of Wikipedia
description: Wizard of Wikipedia is a benchmark dataset for knowledgeable open-domain dialogue, consisting of conversations grounded in Wikipedia knowledge. It enables evaluation of dialogue agents' ability to retrieve, read, and condition on external knowledge to generate informed responses.
typical_sota_score: varies by metric — human evaluation often shows top systems preferred (>70% preference in some studies), while automatic metrics (F1/BLEU) typically range ~30–60% depending on setup
reputation: Widely used benchmark for knowledge-grounded conversational agents.
notes: Dataset includes conversations directly grounded with Wikipedia knowledge; supports supervised learning of knowledge retrieval and response generation.
